SCENE: 장갑 낀 손끝이 서버실 문고리를 잡는 순간, 그 뒤로 압수물 상자를 실은 카트를 밀고 나오는 정장 차림 수사관들과 팔짱을 낀 채 복도 끝에서 지켜보는 검찰 직원들, 형광등이 하얗게 깔린 늦은 오후
SCENE IS THE GROUND TRUTH — every line below only tells you HOW to shoot or draw this exact moment. Where a line below implies a different subject, place, prop or action, keep SCENE and take only the tone, angle, light or framing from that line.
HOOK (the idea this one image must convey — do not add elements beyond SCENE, never render these words as text): 영장은 기각됐는데, 특검은 검찰 전산망을 다시 열었다.
MOOD (the reader's dominant emotion): 는 분노가 아니라 초조함
CAMERA: high-angle shot looking down, diminished and small, belittled, powerless from above, shrinking figure, a frozen split-second; choose an expressive viewpoint — three-quarter, profile, over-the-shoulder or a subtle height shift as the emotion demands, not a flat head-on composition (eye-level dignity does not mean flatness)
LIGHT: flat sterile clinical fluorescent light, cold even greenish-white, emotionless institutional
STAGING (adapt this motif to the scene above, do not copy its literal props): a curtain pulled back revealing what was hidden, a mask half removed, light leaking through an opening exposing the truth
EXPRESSION & ACTION: a fleeting micro-expression flashing across an otherwise composed face
PLAUSIBILITY: this is exactly how the moment would really look to a witness standing there — the clothing, gear, equipment and posture are the ones this specific person, in this role, place, season and hour, would genuinely be wearing and doing, handled the way the task itself demands; each object sits where that task puts it, in the hand that task uses, resting on a real surface; the body is caught at one single point inside one motion, not blended between two different motions.
FRAME: vertical 4:5, the scene fills the entire frame edge to edge — every corner is part of the location, no empty margins or bands; one clear protagonist with a single sharp focal point (eyes, hands, or a key object), background and foreground filled naturally; every person in the scene is KOREAN and the setting is Korea — this is a domestic Korean news story (only if the event is clearly foreign, use the event's actual region and people); depict roles, professions and situations with generic faces.
AVOID: blank/white/black bands, letterbox or borders; watermark or logo; overlay text, captions, headlines or legible lettering (tiny blurred incidental signage only — readable Korean text renders broken); identifiable real individuals; sexualized or gratuitous depiction; any harm involving minors; graphic gore close-ups or a weapon aimed at the viewer (keep the dramatic tension, not shock).
